props.description:
You gain the following benefits based on the current Category of your unarmed strikes.

  • Arcane, brawling, dagger, thrown: your attacks with unarmed strikes treat the Defense of each target as being equal to their current Insight die size.
  • Bow, sword: your attacks with unarmed strikes that target two or more creatures deal 5 extra damage.
  • Firearm, heavy: your unarmed strikes deal 5 extra damage to constructs, and 5 extra damage to non-construct creatures who have at least one shield and/or martial armor equipped.
  • Flail, spear: you gain a +2 bonus to Defense, and your attacks with unarmed strikes may target flying creatures.

If your unarmed strikes are treated as belonging to more than one Category, you gain all the benefits of the corresponding Categories.

props.description:
You gain Flying.

In addition to the obvious advantages in mobility, your melee attacks can target flying creatures and you cannot be targeted by melee attacks unless the attacker is flying or is somehow able to reach flying targets.

props.classMechanic_text:
THERIOFORMS

Therioforms are mutant transformations that grant powerful abilities. Their appearance is up to you—Pterotheria, for example, could mean a person-sized bat or simply large feathered wings. What matters in play are the listed effects of each therioform.

LEARNING THERIOFORMS

Each time you acquire the Theriomorphosis Skill, you learn one therioform (see the list of therioforms). Keep a personal list of the therioforms you know.

USING THERIOMORPHOSIS

You may use an action and spend a portion of your life force to transform.

HP Cost: one third of your current Hit Points (rounded down).
Effect: Manifest up to two therioforms you know at the same time; you immediately gain all listed benefits and traits of the chosen therioforms.

  • You cannot select the same therioform twice.
  • Using Theriomorphosis again replaces your current therioforms with a new selection (this also applies if you access it through other effects such as Genolepsis).

DURATION & ENDING THE FORM

  • Once activated, your chosen therioforms last until the end of the scene.
  • The effects also end immediately if you die, fall unconscious, perform the Guard action, or use Theriomorphosis again.
  • You may willingly end your Theriomorphosis at any time; during a conflict you may only do so on your turn, before or after taking an action.

EXTENDING BETWEEN SCENES

When a scene ends, if you are still under the effects of Theriomorphosis, you may spend 10 MP to carry your current therioforms into the next scene.

props.class_lore: Some say no progress can be achieved without sacrifice; conveniently enough, these sacrifices are rarely made by those in power. Mutants are living testaments to this ruthless arrogance: people whose souls and bodies bear the signs of technological or magical pollution. Each Mutant is a unique being capable of altering their body in strange and unprecedented ways, but their powers come at a painful price and can be a dreadful sight to behold.
